new.name: CVE-2026-133430
new.description: Keycloak: SessionIndex back-channel SAML SLO authenticates via Issuer only — with saml.client.signature=false an unsigned LogoutRequest spoofing the victim Issuer+SessionIndex terminates arbitrary sessions. Official images 26.8.0 vs fixed 26.8.2 (PR #53658): session 1->0 on vuln, 400 rejected on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-117517
new.description: Tomcat 11.0.19-11.0.27: LoadBalancerDrainingValve collapsed leading slashes before stripping ;jsessionid — /;jsessionid=x//evil.example/ becomes a protocol-relative open redirect in draining mode. Incomplete fix of CVE-2026-25854. Real valve from embed-core 11.0.27 vs 11.0.29: //evil redirect on vuln, same-host on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-133481
new.description: Dolibarr 22.0.0-24.0.2: EventAttendees::index() had its access check commented out — a zero-permission authenticated account lists attendee/project data and probes columns via sqlfilters. Real index() from 24.0.2 vs vendor-fixed 24.0.3: HTTP 200 on vuln, 403 on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-77378
new.description: Bolt CMS <6.1.4: ListFormatHelper interpolates content-type slugs into raw SQL — an authenticated upload-permission user injects SQL via /async/select-options. Real getSelect() from 6.1.3 vs vendor-fixed 6.1.4: UNION payload reaches SQL on vuln, bound as parameter on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-63012
new.description: baserCMS <5.3.0: isSameReferrerAsCurrent used an unanchored host prefix match — a lookalike Referer (example.com.evil.test) passes the same-site gate for the Api/Admin session fallback, enabling operator privilege escalation. Real BcUtil from 5.2.3 vs vendor-fixed 5.3.0: lookalike accepted on vuln, exact-match rejected on fixed.

new.name: CVE-2026-77318
new.description: jupyter-mcp-server <1.0.3: standalone streamable-http management routes /api/connect and /api/stop skip MCP_TOKEN enforcement — an unauthenticated PUT resets the server context and points it at an attacker Jupyter backend. Real server v1.0.2 vs vendor-fixed v1.0.3: handler runs on vuln, 401 on fixed.
